game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in The Kingdom – Moat Bridge, the drawbridge over the moat: the town guard must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Rename Rush: Pick valid variable names (no spaces, no leading digits) to unlock doors across the area.
theme: The Kingdom – Moat Bridge: the drawbridge over the moat
core_gameplay_loop: In Moat Bridge, repeat each round: Pick valid variable names (no spaces, no leading digits) to unlock doors across the area. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the valid_names value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about valid_names to power up the town guard and open the granary door.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 7 (applied tier): Rename Rush
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rename Rush' (Week 1 slot 11), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Moat Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how valid_names changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Moat Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 12.
